summary: Proposal splits current Cartographer proposal.md into lightweight proposal, new graph-backed requirements phase, separate design.md phase, then existing plan/implement workflow. Deterministic validate-topic passed with 0 errors/warnings; fact citation summary reports 13 unique proposal citations, 0 missing, 0 unsupported. Auditor should verify scope alignment, ADR metadata, OpenSpec-compatible-not-dependent constraint, and handoff readiness.

Plan created for proposal-design-split with 7 ordered phases P0-P6: workflow contract, requirements graph validators, design graph validators, skill integration, durable requirements fold lifecycle, dashboard/index/artifact summaries, final validation and ADR. Deterministic validate-topic and planning graph validation passed with 74 plan nodes and 171 plan edges. ADR required remains true.

P0 updated README, proposal/plan/implement skills, and workflow docs tests to document the proposal->requirements delta->design lifecycle, scope gate for core user workflow changes, preservation of proposal non-design sections, and docs/requirements.md fold target. P0 validation receipts passed for workflow docs tests, focused rg, prettier, and topic/planning graph validation.

P1 implemented optional requirements graph validation in manage_jsonl.ts and validate_planning_graph.py. Added requirement citation regex, requirement node/edge validation, counts, read-only artifact support for requirements nodes/edges, and tests in manage_jsonl.test.ts plus test_validate_planning_graph.py. Targeted TS tests, Python planning graph tests, check:scripts, and topic/planning graph validation passed.

P1 implemented optional requirements graph validation in manage_jsonl.ts and validate_planning_graph.py. Auditor FAIL was addressed by adding strict stable ID validation (REQ-/SCN-/AC-), reference resolution for scenario_refs, scenario.requirement_id, fact_refs, source_refs, durable docs/requirements refs, stricter durable endpoint handling, private-reference checks over requirement artifacts, requirement citation checks in requirements.md/design.md/plan.md, and temp-root tests covering valid OpenSpec-shaped delta sections plus invalid IDs, unresolved refs, invalid durable refs, private paths, and missing citations. Targeted TS tests, Python planning graph tests, check:scripts, and topic/planning graph validation now pass.

P2 implemented optional design graph validation in manage_jsonl.ts and validate_planning_graph.py. After two auditor FAIL loops, source validation now requires a non-empty string constrained to design.md#heading anchors, and infrastructure_only_rationale must be a non-empty string. Tests cover valid accepted decision plus rejected alternative, fast-follow refs, orphan accepted decision, invalid non-string infrastructure rationale, non-string source, invalid source format, unresolved requirement/fact/edge refs, source heading checks, and private path rejection.

P3 integrated requirements/design workflow guidance into skills and specialist prompts. Plan skill now has explicit Requirements and Design Artifact Guidance for requirements.nodes/edges, design.nodes/edges, ID traceability, scope gate, OpenSpec-style topic/change deltas, docs/requirements.md fold readiness, and ADR preservation. Implement skill auditor handoff now includes requirement/design IDs and summaries. Drafter, compass, and auditor prompts now use read-only summaries of requirements/design artifacts. Workflow docs tests assert artifact boundaries and specialist prompt guidance.

P4 implemented a Cartographer-native requirements fold helper at skills/plan/scripts/requirements_records.py. It folds topic-local requirements.nodes.jsonl deltas into docs/requirements.md or split docs/requirements/<domain>.md, preserving REQ/SCN IDs, change type, domain, priority, status, source topic, renamed_from/supersedes metadata, and receipt references. It appends requirements-fold receipts and validates that topics with requirement deltas have a fold receipt or approved skip receipt, while detecting duplicate durable IDs. README/plan/implement guidance documents durable layout and receipt requirements. Tests cover add/modify/remove, rename, split-domain output, duplicate durable IDs, and missing fold receipts in temp roots.
